notes.title: Patch 1.02 – Correction in Japanese Translation (Rin's Route)
notes.content:
We have fixed a translation issue in the Japanese version of Rin's route.  
We sincerely thank the players who pointed it out, and we apologize for any confusion or inconvenience caused.  
Your continued support is greatly appreciated.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645532/f315454d2e0fb506f1bc675da3415da3a8d6f0f1.png"]

– Marlon

notes.title: New Fantasy Game in Development — Join the Skeleton King: Isekai Harem Patreon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!


I’m excited to announce the launch of my official Patreon for Skeleton King: Isekai Harem — a brand new fantasy game currently in development.


This game invites you into the mysterious world of Magiterra, where the story unfolds in immersive chapters and you can be part of its creation.


By joining the Patreon, you’ll get:



Early access to new story chapters before anyone else;


Exclusive behind-the-scenes content including concept art, scripts, and dev updates;


Opportunities to influence the story through polls and feedback;


Exclusive side stories and unique extras you won’t find anywhere else.



Your support is crucial to help bring this amazing world to life and keep development moving.


If you want to be part of this journey and help shape the future of Magiterra, join us on Patreon today!


👉 https://www.patreon.com/skih


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507981/dd932cf9f7a570443b604a7b181d2b862f89695f.png"]


Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm. Let’s build this fantasy world together!


— Marlon
